test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

__If his father will give money__, he will buy a sports bike.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"will give"** implies a future action but in conditional sentences, we use the present simple tense in the if-clause to indicate a future possibility. (भविष्य की संभावना बताने के लिए 'if-clause' में वर्तमान काल का उपयोग किया जाता है।) • **Example:** If it rains, we **will stay **indoors. • **"Gives"** is the correct present simple tense form used in conditional sentences to indicate a future event. (वर्तमान सरल काल का सही रूप है जो भविष्य की घटना को इंगित करता है।) • **Example:** If she gives permission, we will go on the trip. • Hence, we can infer that the correct form is **'If his father gives money'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: No substitution** (कोई प्रतिस्थापन नहीं): This option suggests that the original sentence is correct, which it is not. • **Example:** No substitution is needed when the sentence is already correct. • **Option 2: If his father give money** (अगर उसके पिता पैसा दे): Incorrect subject-verb agreement as 'father' is singular and should be followed by 'gives'. • **Example:** If he give me the keys, I will drive. (Incorrect) • **Option 3: If his father gave money** (अगर उसके पिता ने पैसा दिया): This implies a past action and does not fit the future conditional context. • **Example:** If he gave me the keys, I would drive. (Past conditional) 3d4:Taec, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
